4.name: T
4.text: No prob’, I dig the colored streak.

5.name: T
5.text: Like you’re hiding it from your parents but still wanted to show off to your friends.

7.name: T
7.text: Not in a bad way, though.

10.name: T
10.text: Honestly, I can’t stand that bitch of a math teacher.

11.name: T
11.text: She almost never comes to class to begin with, yeah?

12.name: T
12.text: And when she does decide to come, she yips and yaps about useless shit that nobody cares about…

13.name: T
13.text: And if she hears even a paper crumple, she starts screaming and tossing and turning like a proper BITCH.

14.name: T
14.text: God, I wish she would just get a boyfriend already to keep her mouth shut.

17.name: T
17.text: Oh, yeah, sorry to bother you so much.

18.name: T
18.text: I’ve just been really nervous, what with the exams and stuff, and that creep…

20.name: T
20.text: Nah, don’t even worry about it.

21.name: T
21.text: Just some paranoia of mine, is all.

24.name: T
24.text: Oh, and ring this milk up, will ya?
